fit.title: ownership adjusted operating
fit.reason: Carvana consolidates its operating LLC although outside LLC holders retain economic interests. An operating valuation must reconcile those interests, Class A/LLC conversion rights and the per-share capital structure; assuming no noncontrolling claim is insufficient. Reported Class A EPS uses its own issuer-defined numerator and dilution rules and is not corrected by dividing consolidated net income by shares. A five-for-one split changed the common-share and LLC-unit basis. The subsequent quarterly filing restates its per-share figures; older annual amounts require a sourced restatement.
